scope: Owner commissions actual production: revise Simian Segue, DK Island Swing, Aquatic Ambiance and Fear Factory; add Life in the Mines and Funky’s Fugue. Build source-faithful instrument/tonal roughs, then expressive cast performances through substantive iterative renders and comparisons, approximately 10–25 revisions as needed. Preserve strong alternate takes and document critical artistic decisions for future whole-game score production. Private review audio, editable sessions, source provenance and public metadata only; no runtime replacement.
finding_effect: Private production studies; does not close runtime audio or owner/device acceptance.

lessons.lesson: MIDI pitch-class agreement and non-silent rendering can conceal an octave error; test sounding fundamental at the actual source range.
A kit/preset name does not establish enabled components, percussion mapping or an active menu selector.
Controller and damping parameters need measured native response; forwarding messages or changing an inactive control is insufficient.
